# docling.rs

> docling.rs is a Rust port of IBM's docling (LF AI & Data): it converts 45+ input formats — PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, EPUB, email (.eml/.msg), images, audio/video and more — into Markdown, docling JSON (`DoclingDocument`), HTML, LaTeX or chunks for LLM and RAG pipelines. PDFs and scans go through layout analysis, TableFormer table structure and OCR running locally on ONNX Runtime — no Python or PyTorch at runtime, no API keys. It ships a Python package with docling's API and Microsoft MarkItDown's API, a CLI, an HTTP server compatible with docling-serve, Node.js and WebAssembly bindings, and a C ABI.

Choosing the entry point:

- Python, coming from MarkItDown: `pip install docling-rs`, then `from docling_rs.markitdown import MarkItDown` — the same `convert()` / `convert_stream()` / `StreamInfo` API. PDFs use the full pipeline after `docling_rs.download_models()`, else their text layer.
- Python, coming from docling: `from docling_rs import DocumentConverter` — `result.document` is a genuine `docling_core` `DoclingDocument`.
- Shell: `docling-rs file.pdf` prints Markdown (`--to json|html|latex|chunks|pandoc|dclx`; `--text-layer-only` skips the ML models for digital PDFs). Install: release binaries, `cargo install docling-cli`, or `ghcr.io/docling-project/docling-rs`.
- AI agents (MCP): `docling-rs mcp` is a Model Context Protocol server with MarkItDown's `convert_to_markdown(uri)` tool plus `convert` and `list_input_formats` — `uvx docling-rs-mcp --root ~/Documents` (PyPI) or `claude mcp add docling -- docling-rs mcp --root ~/Documents`; stdio, or Streamable HTTP with `--http`; registry name `io.github.docling-project/docling-rs`.
- HTTP: `docker run -p 5001:5001 ghcr.io/docling-project/docling-rs-serve`, then `POST /v1/convert`; it also serves docling-serve's routes, so Open WebUI, n8n and Dify can point at it.
- Node.js: `npm i docling.rs`. Browser (fully client-side): `npm i docling.rs-wasm`. Rust: the `docling` crate.
- GPU: `pip install docling-rs-cuda`, `npm i docling.rs-cuda`, or the `cuda`/`coreml`/`directml` cargo features; CPU is the default.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/docling-project/docling.rs/blob/master/README.md): overview, install, CLI, HTTP API, benchmarks against MarkItDown and Python docling
- [docling.rs for MarkItDown users](https://github.com/docling-project/docling.rs/blob/master/docs/MARKITDOWN.md): the drop-in API, measured comparison, open gaps
- [Python package](https://github.com/docling-project/docling.rs/blob/master/crates/docling-py/README.md): docling-shaped API, MarkItDown facade, LangChain loader, chunking, models
- [Rust library guide](https://github.com/docling-project/docling.rs/blob/master/crates/docling/README.md): the API, output formats, chunking, images, streaming, OCR, VLM
- [CLI and MCP server](https://github.com/docling-project/docling.rs/blob/master/crates/docling-cli/README.md): `docling-rs` usage, batch conversion, `docling-rs mcp` for AI agents
- [HTTP server](https://github.com/docling-project/docling.rs/blob/master/crates/docling-serve/README.md): request options, flags, docling-serve drop-in routes, Open WebUI
- [Options](https://github.com/docling-project/docling.rs/blob/master/docs/OPTIONS.md): every conversion option, shared by the CLI, HTTP API and bindings
- [ML models](https://github.com/docling-project/docling.rs/blob/master/docs/MODELS.md): what to download, GPU execution providers, environment overrides
- [Deployment](https://github.com/docling-project/docling.rs/blob/master/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md): containers, server configuration
- [Node.js bindings](https://github.com/docling-project/docling.rs/blob/master/crates/docling-node/README.md)
- [WebAssembly / browser](https://github.com/docling-project/docling.rs/blob/master/crates/docling-wasm/README.md)
